items.computation: Private payment deadline, counted under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1, 193 BGB. The triggering event is the invoice date 21.11.2026; that day is not counted. Counting 21 days forward: 21.11.2026 + 21 days = 12.12.2026. 12.12.2026 is a Saturday?
